about_short_description.short_description: Squadio is a Team as Service platform where organizations find vetted tech squads to manage; for building or improving digital products.

product.name: Tech Talent Hiring
product.description: Organizations can hire vetted technical professionals from a global pool for full-time or part-time remote work.

product.name: Team Management
product.description: Clients fully manage their projects with the hired programming team to achieve project goals.

product.name: Cost Management
product.description: Squadio handles the entire hiring process, including salary and leave management.

product.name: Friendly Replacement
product.description: Immediate replacement is provided if the hired talent's performance does not meet expectations.

product.name: Tech Team Formation and Expansion
product.description: Clients can form or expand their technical team based on their needs, with Squadio facilitating the process.

product.name: Tech Talent Showcase
product.description: Clients can browse previous project achievements of programmers to find professional technical talents.
